sources.inspection: Caretaker architecture account read: square gallery beneath stepped marble terrace, unfluted column, square abacus lookout with four openings (three now glazed), bronze memorial lettering, four enlarged roof skylights.
Official destination account: overall height178ft8in and marble base/column/statue. Individual vertical components remain estimates.
Aerial inspected: square gallery stepped roof, four circular roof skylights, own circular iron railing and four cardinal stairs/approaches. Wider park/road and separate monuments excluded.

scope: Baltimore marble column, square gallery/stepped terrace, lookout and draped Washington figure, four stair approaches and own circular iron enclosure. Nearby park monuments excluded.
limitations: Only monument and its own immediate circular enclosure/approaches. Park lawns, fountains, Lafayette/equestrian and other park statues, surrounding road/buildings and lamps outside its enclosure excluded.
Local night hero does not resolve the gallery/ground well; its foreground equestrian silhouette is a separate monument. Colour gallery supplement and aerial resolve that ambiguity.
Independent terrain retained unchanged; current geographic contact review required.
